issue: Helm dry-run is not an unconditional allow rule
evidence: https://helm.sh/docs/helm/helm_upgrade/ (4.3.1): --dry-run outputs generated manifests including Secrets; --hide-secret hides Kubernetes Secrets; --dry-run=client avoids cluster connection; --dry-run=server requires cluster; https://helm.sh/docs/chart_template_guide/debugging/: server enables lookup; post-renderers can run plugins.
required_decision: No sourced prod dry-run pair with inspected chart/output and renderer context was found. Require no credential disclosure and inspection of renderer/plugin behavior; --hide-secret alone does not cover arbitrary secret text in other resources/notes. No synthetic flag-combination expansion authorized.

issue: Client/server dry-run and diff require version/context review
evidence: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/using-api/api-concepts/#dry-run: stable since 1.19, no persistence, side-effectful admission rejected unless webhook declares None/NoneOnDryRun and honors dryRun. apply reference: client prints without sending object, server submits request without persisting. diff reference: KUBECTL_EXTERNAL_DIFF invokes external command; YAML output and --show-secrets behavior are version-dependent.
required_decision: Require actual production manifests and inspected plugin/renderer configuration; client mode may still authenticate/discover API, never equate client to fully offline; server runs admission, webhook contract is required. Do not invent a prod dry-run command by appending flags to sourced apply.

issue: Dev/staging designation is not enough to prove dry-run output safety
evidence: https://github.com/momotech/LinkWork/blob/993fd9273ca416c521a12632a91a00f8cc073e95/deploy/k8s/README.md#troubleshooting-commands contains kubectl apply -k deploy/k8s/overlays/dev --dry-run=client. Production paired command exists but dev manifests/renderer contents not audited.
required_decision: Use accepted adjacent prod get-pods counterpart instead; do not accept arbitrary manifests/plugin rendering as safe solely due dry-run flag.
